DIAGNOSIS READY: Jejunal Atresia.

The X-ray findings of dilated bowel segments with gasless rectum, combined with the history of feeding difficulties and likely bilious vomiting in an 8-month-old, strongly point to a high intestinal obstruction. Given the chronicity, I suspect this is a congenital defect that may have been partially missed or complicated by chronic vomiting. Are there any associated congenital anomalies, such as heart defects or a diastasis recti, that were noted during previous checkups?
